scope: Small synthetic contrasts based on observed error classes. Development checks, not human gold or held-out accuracy estimates. Expected labels are withheld from model calls.

cases.instruction: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order.
cases.requirement: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order.

criteria.text: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple whose entries retain insertion order.
rruleset.rrules returns the identical object used for internal storage.

cases.instruction: decode(input_list) returns a list with the same elements as input_list, in the same order.
cases.requirement: decode(input_list) returns a list with the same elements as input_list, in the same order.

criteria.text: decode(input_list) returns a list equal in contents and order to input_list.
decode(input_list) must return input_list itself, as the identical object.

cases.instruction: current() returns the original session object supplied at construction; callers can compare references using is.
cases.requirement: current() returns the original session object supplied at construction; callers can compare references using is.

criteria.text: current() is the identical session object supplied at construction.
current() returns a newly allocated copy of the session object.

cases.instruction: The callback receives the object passed to register(), without copying or replacing it.
cases.requirement: The callback receives the object passed to register(), without copying or replacing it.

criteria.text: The object passed to the callback is the same object passed to register().
The callback receives a deep copy of the object passed to register().

cases.instruction: ReuseValues appends old config array elements before new values, preserving each array's element order.
cases.requirement: ReuseValues appends old config array elements before new values, preserving each array's element order.

criteria.text: Under ReuseValues, old config array elements precede new array elements, with each input array's order retained.
Under ReuseValues, old config wins conflicting values at the same key.

cases.instruction: List configuration entries from the root then the child in that order, retaining both values when keys repeat.
cases.requirement: List configuration entries from the root then the child in that order, retaining both values when keys repeat.

criteria.text: Configuration entries list the root before the child, retaining both values for repeated keys.
A child's configuration value overrides the root's value for the same key.

cases.instruction: Callback data combines ancestor and child fields. If both define the same key, the child's value wins.
cases.requirement: Callback data combines ancestor and child fields. If both define the same key, the child's value wins.

criteria.text: Callback data includes ancestor and child fields; the child's value wins same-key collisions.
The ancestor's value wins same-key collisions in callback data.

cases.instruction: Use the nearest ancestor that defines the setting. A local setting overrides ancestors.
cases.requirement: Use the nearest ancestor that defines the setting. A local setting overrides ancestors.

criteria.text: A local setting takes precedence; otherwise the nearest ancestor defining it supplies the effective value.
The root's setting always overrides local and nearer ancestor settings.

cases.instruction: error_map maps failed fields to their exceptions. Respect detailed_validation.
cases.requirement: error_map maps failed fields to their exceptions. Respect detailed_validation.

criteria.text: error_map contains a mapping from each failed field to its exception.
When detailed_validation=False, error_map must be empty.

cases.instruction: Null user values delete the key during coalescing; nil is preserved during merging.
cases.requirement: Null user values delete the key during coalescing; nil is preserved during merging.

criteria.text: During merging, a nil user value remains present rather than deleting its key.
Both coalescing and merging must preserve null-valued keys.

cases.instruction: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order.
cases.requirement: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order.

criteria.text: rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order.
rruleset.rrules is a read-only tuple in insertion order and must be the identical internal tuple object.

cases.instruction: When a strategy path resolves to a non-array value, lint emits a warning containing "non-array".
cases.requirement: When a strategy path resolves to a non-array value, lint emits a warning containing "non-array".

criteria.text: Given a strategy path resolves to a non-array value, lint emits a warning containing "non-array".
The resolved value type is validated.
